universe.name: Marvel Universe: Concise Continuity
universe.description: A curated, fixed-timeline Marvel continuity where real-world present day is in-universe present day. Only cherry-picked events and stories are canon here — edit universe.timelineAnchor and each character's events as you decide what counts.

timelineAnchor.note: Real time = story time. Update currentYear each year, or compute it in js/app.js from Date().
